result.summary: This PR adds functional test coverage in p2p_leak.py and p2p_sendtxrcncl.py for the exact version boundary (nVersion 70016) at which the node begins offering WTXIDRELAY, SENDADDRV2, and SENDTXRCNCL to peers. It adds a peer connecting at exactly the WTXID_RELAY_VERSION threshold and asserts it receives the feature messages, catching a potential off-by-one regression if the '>=' comparison were changed to '>'. A second commit, added after review feedback, extends p2p_sendtxrcncl.py similarly for SENDTXRCNCL.
result.problem: Currently the boundary condition of the version check gating feature-negotiation messages (WTXID_RELAY_VERSION) is untested; a future off-by-one edit to the comparison operator would not be caught by existing tests.

resolved_concerns: naiyoma suggested extending scope to also cover SENDTXRCNCL at the boundary; author agreed and pushed a follow-up commit implementing it.
